answer: To thwart Sybil swarms, our economy binds identities through cryptographic attestation chains and zero-knowledge proofs. Stake pools like juniper cluster, timber lattice, and raven ledger require verification deposits that scale superlinearly: minting $N$ synthetic personas imposes an exponential capital exhaustion of $O(2^N)$ bonded collateral, rendering massive identity duplication mathematically unaffordable.
